POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201
capture acct = $header.Location

# The inner and outer JWS may use different ML-DSA parameter sets.
key new65 ML-DSA-65

POST $dir.keyChange
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $account.jwk}
sign inner new65
$body.status == valid

bind new65 $acct

POST-as-GET $acct as new65
$body.status == valid

# The old key's algorithm no longer matches the account's key.
POST-as-GET $acct
error == malformed

POST $dir.newAccount as new65
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
$header.Location == $acct

key new87 ML-DSA-87

POST $dir.keyChange as new65
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $new65.jwk}
sign inner new87
$body.status == valid

bind new87 $acct

POST-as-GET $acct as new87
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $acct as new65
error == malformed

POST $dir.newAccount as new87
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
$header.Location == $acct
